title: Sales Automations
meta: Tasks, reminders and field updates that run on their own inside your CRM, so repeat work stops. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Sales automations that handle the repeat work
overview: We find the small jobs your team repeats every day and turn them into automatic steps in your CRM. When a deal moves stage, a task is created. When a lead goes quiet, the owner gets nudged. When a deal is won, the right fields update and a welcome message is queued for approval. We build each workflow, test it on sample records and write one line explaining what it does, so nothing runs as a mystery.

Eight workflows with conditions, tasks and deal updates.

pkgs.blurb: A full automation set with approvals, testing and documentation.
list: Approval step before any customer email

faq: Tasks, reminders, owner changes, field updates, internal alerts and email drafts. It depends on the CRM plan you have. We list what is possible on your plan before we build, so there are no surprises.
Will it email customers without a person?
Not unless you ask and your CRM allows it. By default customer messages are drafted or queued for a person to approve. Premium adds a clear approval step, so nothing goes out by accident.
We test each workflow on sample records first, and Premium adds error alerts to an admin. Every automation can be paused with one switch, and our notes explain how and where to do it.

Basic and Standard work inside your CRM. Linking outside apps such as forms or a store needs an integration step, which we can quote separately if it is not covered by your CRM's built in connections.
